kirangaikwadkg1@gmail.com | 9834994060 | Pune, Maharashtra, India 
 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY  
Capital Markets Operations professional of experience across Trade Processing, Settlements, Reconciliation, 
Exception Management, Risk & Controls, and Client Service. Proven ability to manage end-to-end trade lifecycle 
activities across US brokerage and wealth management environments, resolve complex operational exceptions, 
handle client escalations, and lead teams toward operational excellence. Adept at stakeholder management, root 
cause analysis, process improvement, and driving automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

products.

Reconciliation & Risk Controls

regulatory requirements. 
• Prepared management reports, KPI/KRI metrics, and operational dashboards to support senior management 
decision-making. 
• Conducted root cause analysis on recurring breaks and implemented corrective actions to prevent recurrence. 
Leadership & Team Management

adherence to SLAs and KRIs. 
• Provided coaching, mentoring, and structured training to new and existing team members, improving 
operational accuracy. 
• Managed escalations from clients and senior stakeholders, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolution. 
• Led process improvement and automation initiatives across reconciliation and settlement workflows, reducing 
manual effort and operational risk. 
• Supported business change programmes and implementation of new operational controls.
